in_sanskrit.name: Bhom
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhom एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.

in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Earth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhom एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.

in_tamil.name: Bhom
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bhom ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.

in_telugu.name: Bhom
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhom ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.

in_marathi.name: Bhom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhom हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.

in_bengali.name: Bhom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhom একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bho’, meaning ‘earth’. It is a name that represents the strength and power of the earth element.
